title: Book Two · Chapter 199: The Last Page of the Term
story:
At the end of the school term, Ronan returns his last borrowed book. The card goes back into its box. The book goes onto the checked side of the desk.

Mei is finishing the group record with Leo. Their group work ends with this school year. The school will plan next year's work later.

Ronan waits at the public table. He has a sheet about the next stage of school. The page gives a first meeting time, a list of books, and a note for families.

He reads the top date before anything else. Then he checks the place. The meeting is at a different building from his present classroom.

Miss Wu comes to take the returned book. She asks if his family has the new sheet.

“I am taking it home today,” he says.

“Please read the family note with them.”

He nods. This is the usual family note. Everyone in the new school year gets the same information.

At the gate, Jun stops beside him. He has a holiday drawing plan in his bag.

“See you by the river some day?” Jun asks.

“Tell me the day first.”

“I will ask the others too.”

Ronan smiles. “Good.”

They say goodbye. Jun leaves with his own plans. Ronan walks toward River Street. At a quiet corner, he stops to read the book list again. He folds it away before he starts walking again.

At home, Mum is talking to a customer at the door. They agree on a time to collect the clothes. Then she says goodbye and takes Ronan's school sheet.

Dad reads it after work. His hands are clean, but there is a pale mark near one fingernail. Mr Sun still has several jobs for him next week. Dad writes his available time beside the family meeting date.

Mum checks her own work book before she agrees on the hour.

“We can manage this,” she says.

Ronan reads the family note aloud. He stops at one unfamiliar word. Dad looks at it and shakes his head. Mum knows part of the meaning. But she cannot explain the whole instruction.

Ronan writes the whole sentence on a small note. He marks the word he does not know. He will ask the school office before the holiday meeting.

“Not a guess?” Dad asks.

“Not for this one.”

Mum folds the family sheet and puts it beside her work book. Ronan carries the cups away from the table.

Later, he opens his own school book to its last used page. There is a little room at the bottom. He writes the office question there. Then he closes the book. He puts it on the shelf for tomorrow.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

available＝有空、可用的；unfamiliar＝不熟悉的；instruction＝指示；manage＝安排得过来。

## 理解问题

1. 家人怎样把新的学校安排和各自工作实际协调起来？
2. 遇到不懂的完整指示时，Ronan准备怎样核实？

## 读句子

**He stops at one unfamiliar word.**

拆开看：He / stops / at one unfamiliar word.

他／停在／一个不熟悉的词处。
